 Mars Snacking builds out leadership after Kellanova acquisition
 By Deniz Ataman 16-Nov-2026 Last updated on 16-Nov-2026 at 14:15 GMT 
 João Belo, Global Vice President of Corporate Affairs, Mars Snacking. (Image: Mars, Incorporated) The snacking giant names João Belo global VP of corporate affairs as it grows its manufacturing footprint and integrates Kellanova
 João Belo will serve as global VP of corporate affairs for Mars Snacking, effective Jan. 4, 2027. Belo’s appointment comes as Mars scales its leadership team to oversee a broader snacking operation following its acquisition of Kellanova, which significantly expanded the company’s brand portfolio, manufacturing footprint and global reach.
 Belo joins the leadership team alongside Mars Snacking Global President Andrew Clarke. His appointment comes as Mars continues integrating Kellanova into its snacking business following the company’s $35.9 billion acquisition in December 2025.
 Belo will lead the division’s global communications , public affairs and community impact as Mars brings together a broader snack portfolio that now includes brands such as Pringles, Pop-Tarts, Cheez-It, alongside Snickers, M&Ms and Skittles.
 Mars Snacking invests billions in operations and production expansion
 Belo’s leadership announcement follows the company’s ongoing efforts to expand and streamline the business. Last week, Mars announced a $1.4 billion investment across its US snacking and pet care operations. The investment builds on the company’s $9 billion-plus investment in US operations since 2017.
 Since acquiring Kellanova, Mars has added 15 facilities in the last year. The company is prioritizing expanded production for Snickers, Skittles and Starburst in the Waco, Texas, facility, and increased manufacturing for the Tru Fru frozen snacks line in Salt Lake City, Utah. 
 Explore related questions
 The company also closed its its former Newark, NJ, headquarters, cutting 307 jobs, moving it to Chicago. The company will continue its innovation and manufacturing facility in Hackettstown, NJ.
